setup.title: Set up your shop
setup.noTokenTitle: This page needs the setup link
setup.noTokenBody: Open the link printed in the terminal where AI Commerce started. To print it again, run “docker compose logs server” and look for the line that ends in /setup?token=…
setup.finishedBody: This shop is already set up, so the setup page is locked for good.

errors.network: The server did not answer. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.token: The setup link is not valid any more. Open the link printed in the terminal again.

database.title: Database check
database.failedTitle: The shop cannot reach its server or database
database.failedBody: Check that the server and database containers are running (“docker compose ps”) and that DATABASE_URL points to the database. Then try again.

owner.title: Create the owner account
owner.intro: The owner can do everything in this shop. Next, you will turn on two-factor authentication.
owner.name: Name
owner.nameInvalid: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
owner.exists: An owner already exists. Reload the page to continue setup.

twoFactor.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Admins sign in with a code from an authenticator app as well as their password.
twoFactor.signIn: Sign in as the owner to continue.
twoFactor.wrongPassword: The email or password is wrong.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key into it.
twoFactor.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.backupHint: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe now: they are not shown again.
twoFactor.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check that your phone's clock is correct, then try a new code.

shop.title: Your shop
shop.name: Shop name
shop.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
shop.aiKeyHint: A Gemini, Claude or OpenAI key. It is stored encrypted, and you can add it later.
shop.aiKeyInvalid: The key is longer than 500 characters.

features.title: Features
features.label: Start with
features.minimalHint: Only what every shop needs. You can switch features on later.
features.fullHint: Every feature that ships with AI Commerce.
features.customHint: Tick features one by one. Anything they need is ticked for you.
features.signInNeeded: To choose features one by one, sign in as the owner. Or start with a preset.
features.empty: There are no features to choose from.
features.invalid: A chosen feature is not available. Reload the page and choose again.

modules.systemHint: Settings, attributes, background jobs and switching features on and off.
modules.sampleHint: A small example that shows how a module is built. Safe to switch off.

extras.title: Import and sample data
extras.blocked: A step is not finished yet. Reload the page to continue where you left off.

done.title: Your shop is ready
done.next: The dashboard arrives in M1. Until then, you can check your account.
